name: False Life
levelText: alchemist 2, arcanist 2, bloodrager 2, investigator 2, medium 2, mesmerist 2, occultist 2, psychic 2, shaman 2, sorcerer 2, spiritualist 2, witch 2, wizard 2
componentsText: V, S, M (a drop of blood)
duration: 1 hour/level or until discharged; see text
description: You harness the power of unlife to grant yourself a limited ability to avoid death. While this spell is in effect, you gain temporary hit points equal to 1d10 + 1 per caster level (maximum +10).
